title: CNC Mill and Lathe Machines; Industrial Band Saw for Camp Humphreys, Korea
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.AMC.ACC.ACC-OO.411TH CSB.0906 AQ CO     CONTRACTING BAT
description_text: The contractor shall provide all labor, tools, equipment and supplies to deliver and install a Turning Center CNC Machine, a Machining Center CNC, and an Industrial Band Saw. The contract includes white-glove delivery, installation, 80 hours of comprehensive on-site trainingfor operators, and all necessary resources to ensure the equipment is fully operational. Please see attached PWS, and Salient Characteristics for further details.
